AzureAI._AgentModels_Comment: Optional per-agent model overrides. Empty = all agents use DefaultModel. Valid agent keys: SolutionArchitect, BusinessAnalyst, DataModelBuilder, UIBuilder, DataPopulation, Tester, SecurityBuilder, AutomationBuilder. Example: { "DataModelBuilder": "gpt-4o-mini", "SecurityBuilder": "gpt-4o" } — pin SB to the smarter model if privilege-matrix reasoning starts hallucinating GUIDs.

Dataverse._VerboseLogging_Comment: Set to true to log every Dataverse HTTP request + response body (Information level). Off by default — bodies can contain schema/env detail.
